title: Invincible in the Apocalypse
altTitles: Invincible in the Apocalypse: Proposing Marriage at Your Doorstep
Apocalypse-Invincible, They Proposed at His Doorstep
I Became Invincible Right as the Apocalypse Began, and My Blind Dates Showed Up and All of Them Are Walking Weapons of Mass Destruction
末世刚无敌提亲堵上门
末世刚无敌提亲堵上门
description: Right after becoming invincible in the apocalypse, the protagonist unexpectedly finds himself going on blind dates. The problem is that every one of his potential suitors is essentially a walking weapon of mass destruction. What begins as an absurd series of encounters in a post-apocalyptic world quickly turns into a dangerous and chaotic adventure.
author: Hui Xing Dong Man
